name: Renowned beautiful girl figure manufacturer MIMEYOI presents its 10th figure case, a stunning display designed to perfectly complement Javelin’s Blissful Purity Ver. from Azur Lane! The background design is meticulously crafted to match the elegant aesthetic of the figure, enhancing its delicate details. Inside the case, creating the effect of a real stage presence.
